title: 8 Application Security Posture Management (ASPM) Platforms: Our Top Picks by Use Case (2026)
content_md: Quick Answer: ASPM exists because you bought five scanners and got five backlogs. Aggregation-first (unify the tools you have): ArmorCode and Kondukto scanner-agnostic correlation, deduplication, and SLA workflow. Native-engine platforms (replace point scanners): Cycode, OX Security, and Backslash bring their own secrets/SCA/SAST plus posture. Design-and-risk-graph depth: Apiiro code-change risk assessment from design to runtime. Pipeline-integrity focus: Legit Security securing the factory, not just the code. Consolidated note: Enso Security became Snyk AppRisk buy it as Snyk’s ASPM lane, not a standalone. Who This Guide Is For AppSec leads reconciling findings from six tools into one truthful queue, CISOs who need “are we getting better?” answered per product line, and platform teams securing CI/CD pipeline security execution against tampering. Eight picks organized by architectural bet aggregate what exists, replace with native engines, or model risk from design. How We Selected (Our Method) Research-based evaluation focusing on connector breadth, deduplication and correlation quality, native-engine depth where claimed, risk-scoring transparency, workflow/SLA tooling, transparent pricing structures, and consolidation clarity specifically reviewing transitions such as Enso to Snyk AppRisk .
